project.name: blog-api-backend
project.description: A RESTful Express + TypeScript API for managing blog posts and user authentication with MongoDB and JWT.

features.name: Blog listing
features.description: Fetch all blog posts without authentication.

endpoints.description: Returns all blogs in the collection.

features.name: Blog CRUD
features.description: Create, update, and delete blog posts for authenticated users only.

endpoints.description: Creates a blog post using the logged-in user's JWT identity.
Updates a blog post if the current user is the original author.
Deletes a blog post if the current user is the original author.

features.name: User auth
features.description: Register new users and login to receive a JWT token.

endpoints.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

features.name: Health checks
features.description: Confirms the backend is running and responsive.

endpoints.description: Returns a basic health message to confirm the service is running.

knownLimitations.issue: The server exits if MongoDB is unavailable.
knownLimitations.impact: The service cannot start without a configured MongoDB connection.
